origin: Original MIT owned SM2 vertex and 128-ADD/FRC pixel shader; not game-derived
binding_profile: VS set0, PS set1; constant sets bindings0..2, SRVs16..31, samplers32..47
interstage: vertex output is compiled against the actual pixel input signature using vkd3d_shader_build_varying_map
owned_output_normalization: SM2 allows only MOV to oC0; upstream owned HLSL output FRC oC0,r0 is preserved as FRC r0,r0 then MOV oC0,r0. Fixture generator only; game bytecode is never patched.
pixel_profile: ps_2_a: extended instruction budget; ps_2_0 has a separate 64-arithmetic limit
